_help: Act 6 start, at Akmentar: Rashad and Bashir stay to hold the guardian. Sets the countdowns (thieves 7, mummy 9 days), keeper_horses = 2 (count them toward enough_horses), and with temple_studied the stronger ritual: mummy +1 (ritual_shared). Then the board act6_return. Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act67.py.

start.speaker: rashad
start.line: We stay. My people and I will hold him here as long as the old words allow. It will not be long enough. That part is yours.

count.speaker: rashad
count.line: The thieves will reach Cairo before you, and they will not wait there. The guardian follows the amulet. Each day you spend on the road, he spends too.

choices.label: Ask for horses
choices.line: We haven't enough animals for everyone.

choices.label: Share the temple ritual
choices.line: At the temple on the desert road we copied a rite. Three gods, three keys, and the bound man. Can you use it?

choices.label: Promise to bring it back
choices.line: We'll bring the jars and the amulet back. All of them.

which_americans.speaker: rashad
which_americans.line: Americans will want a boat. They trust machines. But we do not know their road, only their nature.

which_germans.speaker: rashad
which_germans.line: Germans with a treasure ride hard and straight. Horses, I would think, across the sand. But I cannot promise you.

which_italians.speaker: rashad
which_italians.line: The Italians came by the coast, with their trucks. Perhaps they leave the same way. Perhaps not.

which_none.speaker: rashad
which_none.line: We do not know. Only that it goes toward Cairo.

horses.speaker: bashir
horses.line: Two horses. We can spare two, and they are good ones. More, and we cannot ride to the circles we must keep.

ritual.speaker: rashad
ritual.line: ...Yes. Yes, with this the binding holds a day longer. You spent a day at that temple, and it has bought the world a day. Remember that.

promise.speaker: rashad
promise.line: I will hold you to it. So will he.

go.speaker: rashad
go.line: Go with God. And do not stop for the dead on the road. They are not yours to bury.
